title: GFT UK is marked do-not-pitch on a mechanical rescore, with its platform stack never researched
content:
GFT UK's row carries two verticals, banking and insurance, and a tool field that reads "not researched". Its do-not-pitch tier came from a mechanical rescore of a provisional v2 tail entry using size and slot occupancy, with no v3 evidence pass.

Because the platform record is empty, only one of the two scoring inputs could actually be computed. That leaves size as the effective basis for the exclusion, which is a defensible screen but a different claim from having established that the firm has no room for a new component.

The flag's own instruction underlines the gap: run the OSS-portfolio screen before acting. An exclusion accompanied by a request for the evidence that would justify it should be read as a triage decision rather than a settled verdict.
